No front door

No free way in, no clear first yes

Someone finds you through a reel feeling seen, and then has to go looking for the next step across sessions, workshops, a bootcamp, an app and a waitlist on your Linktree. Most people who have to go looking don't.

No qualifier

Your best fits look like everyone else

The people ready to invest in deeper support scroll past the same posts as everyone else. Nothing asks them to raise their hand, and there is no high-ticket programme open to invite them into.

No average order value

One product per buyer, at best

Without an order bump and an upsell, each buyer picks one product and stops. The same buyer could take two or three in one checkout.

The people who trust your voice but aren't ready for 1:1 today have no free way in and no first step that leads anywhere, so most of them buy nothing.

A [$27] boundaries starter kit that pays for your ads and fills a new high-ticket 1:1 programme

Say no without the guilt spiral: 7 days to boundaries that actually hold

Instant digital access · 7 days · about 10 minutes a day

Sound familiar?

You know what a boundary is. Holding one is the hard part.

  • You've walked away from a narcissistic partner, parent or ex, or you're still dealing with one.
  • You say yes, then replay it and resent it for days.
  • You rehearse the conversation in your head and still freeze or over-explain when it matters.
  • Saying no comes with a wave of guilt, so you keep the peace instead.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things the seven days cover

01

Spot the push

The common pressure tactics that make you drop a boundary, so you see them coming instead of replaying them later.

02

Say it simply

Short, word-for-word scripts for family, exes and work, so you stop over-explaining.

03

Reply calmly

Templates for texts and emails that keep you clear and brief when a message is designed to pull you in.

04

Hold the line

What to do when someone tests the boundary a second and third time.

05

Drop the guilt

Why guilt shows up after a healthy no, and a simple daily practice for letting it pass.

Questions

Before you start

Who is this for?

Anyone who knows what a boundary is but struggles to say it and hold it, especially with a narcissistic partner, parent or ex.

How much time does it take?

Seven days, about 10 minutes a day. Each day is a short video lesson with a script or template to use straight away.

What's the Guilt Detox add-on?

It's Adriana's Guilt Detox, offered as a one-tick add-on at checkout for [$17]. It's optional.

How do I get access?

Access is instant and digital. Your login arrives by email straight after checkout. Reply "YES" to that email so the daily lessons land in your main inbox.

Is this therapy?

No. It's coaching and education, not therapy or medical advice. If you're in danger, contact your local emergency services.

Two ways to answer a guilt-trip text

Hook: over-explaining vs one calm sentence

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Stop over-explaining"

Hook
"If your no comes with three paragraphs of explanation, this is for you." (to camera, close framing)
Body
"The more you explain, the more there is to argue with. A boundary is one clear sentence you can repeat. I learned that the hard way, and it's the first thing I teach now." (on-screen text: one sentence, repeat)
CTA
"My 7-Day Boundary Shift gives you the exact scripts, ten minutes a day. Tap Learn more."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three sentences to save"

Hook
"Screenshot this. Three sentences that end a circular argument." (Adriana holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: I'm not available for that conversation. Two: I've already answered. Three: I'm going to go now." (each line appears as a caption)
CTA
"There are dozens more in my 7-day starter kit, sorted by family, exes and work. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Why the guilt shows up"

Hook
"Feeling guilty after you set a boundary doesn't mean you did it wrong." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Guilt is often just the feeling of doing something new. If you were taught that keeping the peace was your job, a calm no will feel wrong at first. That feeling passes faster when you have the words ready."
CTA
"That's what the 7-Day Boundary Shift is for: the words, and a daily practice for the guilt. Tap Learn more."
